site.name: GitHub
site.summary: Strong clarity and product storytelling with a few opportunities to improve primary CTA emphasis.

recommendations.title: Reposition the primary CTA
recommendations.description: Give the main action more visual weight and reduce competing prompts above the fold.
recommendations.reasoning: CTA prominence strongly affects conversion intent.

recommendations.title: Shorten supporting copy
recommendations.description: Trim the first screen to a tighter value proposition and faster next-step language.
recommendations.reasoning: Visitors scan quickly and respond to clarity.

recommendations.title: Add more trust cues
recommendations.description: Introduce social proof and customer outcomes near the core conversion area.
recommendations.reasoning: Trust signals reduce hesitation for first-time visitors.

weaknesses: Limited social proof near the hero
